newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 22.

text.p: All major ports were open as of 1000 local/1600 GMT, Communications and Transport Ministry said in a daily update.
Strong winds and waves up to 15 feet high were reported along the Gulf of California.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

High pressure zone along the northwest of the Baja California peninsula, with possible rains. Winds from the north 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour) causing waves of four to six feet high along Baja California, Sonora, Sinaloa and Nayarit. Same wind speed and clouds from Jalisco to Oaxaca states, with light isolated rains.
Winds of 15 to 25 knots (28 to 47 km/17 to 28 miles per hour) with waves of 12 to 15 feet high in the Gulf of California.

High pressure front over the Gulf of Mexico and gusty winds reported along northern gulf. Stable conditions along rest of shore with probable freezes in the northeast of the country. Winds from the south and southeast at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour).

Some isolated wind gusts along the coast of Nicaragua, with clouds and possible rains on coasts of Quintana Roo state and Belize. Winds from the east and northeast at 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/17 to 22 miles per hour) with waves three to five feet high.
